record.question: Which safety zone is defined as the area where the magnetic field is strong enough to pose a significant risk to unscreened individuals and ferromagnetic objects, and from which all ferromagnetic objects must be excluded?
record.explanation: Answer C: Zone III.. ACR MRI Zone III is controlled access because unscreened persons and ferromagnetic objects can pose significant hazards. Source/context note: ACR Zone III is a restricted-access controlled area. The stem wording should distinguish Zone III from Zone IV scanner room. Reference: https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/mri; https://cs.acr.org/-/media/ACR/Files/Radiology-Safety/MR-Safety/Manual-on-MR-Safety.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
